arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_transactions FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND date >= '2019-03-01' AND date < '2019-04-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions with type 'Online Transaction' dated in March 2019.
assumptions: Online transactions are those with transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'.
March 2019 means 2019-03-01 up to but not including 2019-04-01.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, including those with errors or negative amounts.
